scripts.ci: bun run ci:backend && bun run ci:frontend
scripts.ci:backend: cd backend && bunx prisma validate && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.ci:frontend: cd frontend && bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck
scripts.pre-push: bun run typecheck && bun run ci
scripts.build: cd backend && bun run build && cd ../frontend && bun run build
